Every big launch starts an argument about who won it. This app answers it with posts from the first seventy-two hours on X, side by side.
Here's how it works. Grok samples posts from X through the xAI API, with X Search. Everything after that runs on Modal.
Here's how it works. Grok samples posts from X through the ex A I API, with X Search. Everything after that runs on Modal.

Inside Modal, a cron schedule calls refresh every six hours. Refresh uses map to analyze each launch in its own container, in parallel. Results land in a Modal Dict, and a web endpoint serves the public page.

Inside Modal, a kron schedule calls refresh every six hours. Refresh uses map to analyze each launch in its own container, in parallel. Results land in a Modal Dict, and a web endpoint serves the public page.
Why Modal? A laptop script stops when the laptop sleeps, and a server sits idle between refreshes. Modal scales to zero between runs and bills by the second. The xAI key stays in a Modal Secret.
